objections.finding: BA cites only BashView as compact inline reference, but user explicitly said 'bash + subagent'. Subagent (TaskView) has a specialized inline view showing sub-tool status row. BA's proposed approach (minimal:true, no specialized view) produces an even stricter minimal than either reference.
objections.impact: Likely benign — user said '简化' (simplify), so stricter minimal aligns with intent. Dev should be aware that BashView is NOT a pure header-only pattern — BashView has a specialized inline view that shows '$ command' + preview stdout/stderr. BA's approach intentionally drops even that preview and shows only header + compact summary line via extractDescription. This is defensible as the most 'simplified' interpretation.
objections.recommendation: Acceptable as-is. Dev should ensure extractDescription produces a reasonable one-line input summary (e.g. 'CronList {}' or 'CronList (N jobs)' when result parseable). Do NOT register CronList in toolViewRegistry — that would undo the minimal gating.

objections.finding: Spec §5.18 point 4 says this change 'establishes the rule for tool cards broadly' (§5.15 adoption). BA scopes tightly to CronList without noting the downstream implication for §5.15.
objections.impact: Acceptable for this cycle. §5.15 is a separate spec item (Codex tool coverage) that will be addressed in its own cycle.
objections.recommendation: No rework needed. PM/orchestrator should ensure §5.15 cycle BA references the CronList pattern established here.

objections.finding: BA Should Have section mentions extractDescription should show 'N scheduled jobs' by parsing the result string 'No scheduled jobs.'. Parsing 'No scheduled jobs.' to count=0 requires fragile string matching. No contract for CronList result structure exists.
objections.impact: Dev may implement a brittle string parse. If result format changes (e.g., different locale), description could become incorrect.
objections.recommendation: Dev should prefer the simpler Must Have path: show 'CronList {}' or 'CronList (truncated input)' based ONLY on input, not on result parsing. The Should Have 'N scheduled jobs' can be deferred or skipped if it requires fragile string matching.
